resources.scope: current_process_only; excludes separate model servers and child processes
resources.peak_definition: OS high-water mark since process start, not a per-workload peak

limitations: Six related operational scenarios, 48 different requests; repeated queries are not independent samples.
Literal evidence filtering is not entailment: unsupported relations retain all entity/version terms.
Visible-label synthetic regression; thresholds are unchanged, no generalization claim.
Controlled snapshots bypass ingestion; lifecycle and ingestion are tested separately.
HashEmbedding only; not native SDK performance or a new V11 verification.
Fixed .265 across local ablations is diagnostic, not a separately optimized threshold for each mode.
RSS is current process; high-water mark covers process lifetime and excludes external model servers.
Optional content_coverage_v1 is lexical abstention, not entailment; it can reject supported paraphrases.
